classes.description: HR policy documents and employee handbooks chunked for RAG retrieval

properties.name: documentId
properties.description: UUID of the document in the documents table

properties.name: filename
properties.description: Original filename of the uploaded document

properties.name: chunkIndex
properties.description: Zero-based index of this chunk within the document

properties.name: chunkTotal
properties.description: Total number of chunks in this document

properties.name: pageNumber
properties.description: Page number this chunk originates from (if applicable)

properties.name: uploadedBy
properties.description: UUID of the user who uploaded the document

properties.name: createdAt
properties.description: Timestamp when the chunk was indexed
